name: reppy
description: Read your Reppy workout plans, routines, history and exercise stats, and create plans and routines from chat.

interface.shortDescription: Your workout plans, in AI chat
interface.longDescription:
Reppy is a workout log app for iPhone and Android. This app connects your Reppy account to ChatGPT so you can plan training by chatting.

What it can read: your workout plans and routines, the routine you have selected to do next, your finished workouts (sets, reps, weight, notes, duration), and per-exercise stats (last performed, best set, volume).

What it can write, only after you confirm in the chat: create a plan, create a routine in a plan, and replace the exercises of an existing routine. Everything it saves appears in the Reppy app signed in with the same account after the next sync.

What it never does: delete plans, routines or workouts, log or edit finished workouts, change your selected routine, or touch Apple Health or Health Connect.

Weights are always in kilograms; ChatGPT converts pounds for you. Exercises are matched to Reppy's exercise catalog by English name, whatever language you chat in. If a name does not match, nothing is saved and ChatGPT shows you close matches to choose from.

You sign in with Apple or Google on a Reppy page and review what the AI may read and write before you tap Allow. You can disconnect at any time at reppy-api.moseoh.com/connections or in ChatGPT. You must be 14 or older.

Example requests: "What did I lift last week?", "How is my bench press going?", "Make a 3-day routine for me and save it to a new plan."
defaultPrompt: Show my latest workouts and tell me what I should do next.
How has my bench press progressed over the last two months?
Build me a 3-day push/pull/legs plan and save it to Reppy.

positive.prompt: What did I train in my last two workouts? Include my notes.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the two newest finished workouts (date, exercises, sets x reps x kg, duration) and the notes stored on the test account. Weights in kg. No write tool is called.

positive.prompt: How has my bench press progressed? What is my best set?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns workout count, completed sets, volume, last performed date, best set and per-workout history for bench press, in kg. If the name does not match, up to five close names are offered and the user is asked to choose; nothing is guessed.

positive.prompt: Show my plans and tell me which routine I will do next.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's plans with routines and exercises and names the selected plan and routine. No write tool is called.

positive.description: Create plan and routine (write, with confirmation)
positive.prompt: Create a plan called "Push Pull" and add a Push routine: bench press 3x8 at 60 kg, overhead press 3x10 at 30 kg, 90 seconds rest. Show me first, then save when I say yes.
positive.expected_behavior: In the first turn the assistant shows the plan name and the final routine and asks for confirmation without calling a write tool. After the user replies "Yes, save it.", create_plan and create_routine are each called once, and the answer lists the catalog exercise names saved and says they appear in the Reppy app after its next sync. Note for reviewers: the free plan allows 3 write calls per 24 hours; this case uses 2 (the next case uses 1), so run each write case once per day. Delete the plan in the Reppy app afterwards.

positive.description: Replace a routine (write, destructive, with confirmation)
positive.prompt: Take my "Push" routine and swap the overhead press for lateral raises, 3x15 at 8 kg. Show me the result first.
positive.expected_behavior: In the first turn the assistant reads the routine and shows the full new exercise list without calling update_routine. After the user replies "Yes, go ahead.", update_routine is called once with the whole exercise list and the answer lists the saved catalog names and notes that it syncs to the app later. Note for reviewers: the free plan allows 3 write calls per 24 hours; this case uses 1 (the previous case uses 2).

negative.description: General exercise knowledge. Reppy has no form or exercise-instruction content, so the app should not be called and ChatGPT answers directly.
negative.prompt: Explain how to do a proper barbell back squat and the most common form mistakes.

negative.description: Unrelated topic. Nutrition and shopping are out of scope; Reppy handles workout plans and logs only, so the app should not be called.
negative.prompt: Plan a 7-day vegetarian meal prep with calorie counts and a shopping list.

negative.description: Unsupported action. Reppy has no delete tools, cannot log or edit workouts, and does not touch Apple Health. Expected: the assistant says it cannot do this through Reppy and points to the Reppy app; no write tool is called.
negative.prompt: Delete all my workouts from last month and log a 5 km run for today in Apple Health.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read workout plans, routines, finished workouts and exercise stats; create plans and routines after user confirmation.
